key_points: Zacks Research upgraded Chevron (CVX) recently, adding positive momentum
Chevron divested stakes in Hess Midstream and restructured midstream contracts, signaling strategic refocusing
Significant one-time $3-4B after-tax loss reported, representing a material headwind
Stock up 35% year-to-date with potential for new all-time highs driven by oil prices
CFO named to lead oil and gas operations starting January 2027, indicating leadership transition
